Consistently Hits High Marks
May 2018 • Family
This is the place to go and grab a seat at the sushi bar. Here you will see a committed focus on great fish and skill of the team. High quality offerings of fish, clams and shelled critters, many things flown in from the Japanese markets. What these guys do with it, once removed from the case, is delicious art. Less great at times are the dishes from the kitchen. The focus here is good fish and artful technique. I've not found and equal yet in HCMC.

Overated
Aug 2015 • Friends
The menu was impressive but the food was disappointing. 
Oyster shooter - plump oyster but the cocktail was too sour. the quail egg yolk might as well not be there. 
Miso cod fish - too đry, overcooked 
Sashimi - nice thick cuts, fresh 
Tako wasabi- slivers of orange peel added a nice citrus taste 
dashi tamago - definitely worth trying, freshly cooked, although more dashi would have given it more taste 
grilled bamboo shoot, - how do you eat something so hard and asteless? With wasabi?! 
ebi hotare tsukune - interesting but dry 
Overall, more fusion than Japanese. no dessert menu.

High price, extremely small portions
Jul 2015 • Couples
Ridiculously small portions. 
We ordered the pork ribs that cost nearly 10 usd and got 1 rib that was 1.5 inches and 2 ribs that were 2 inches long. I thought it was a joke.!!??? The rib had very little meat on the bone. For another $7.00 we got the crab roll which was 6 small pieces. Another ridiculously small portion. Ended up paying $20.00 usd for several small bites of food. We have come to Saigon every summer for the past 10 years and this year we have found that the foreigners who open restaurants in Saigon, have really raised prices and give small portions. They seem to know the local rich don't care how much they pay, and both local and foreign business men are on an expense account, so they don't worry about the price of meals. Therefore the foreign restaurants are really taking advantage of these type customers. I will no longer go to these type restaurants.
